oidcClientId.title: OIDC Client ID
oidcClientId.description: Client ID from your registered application at https://developer.cloud.daikineurope.com

oidcClientSecret.title: OIDC Client Secret
oidcClientSecret.description: Client Secret from your registered application at https://developer.cloud.daikineurope.com

oidcCallbackServerExternalAddress.title: Callback Server External Address
oidcCallbackServerExternalAddress.description: Externally reachable hostname or IP of the machine running Matterbridge. Must match the Redirect URI registered in the Daikin Developer Portal (https://<address>:<port>/daikin-oauth-callback). 'localhost' / '127.0.0.1' is rejected by Daikin.

oidcCallbackServerPort.title: Callback Server Port
oidcCallbackServerPort.description: TCP port the callback HTTPS server listens on (must match the registered Redirect URI).

pollIntervalMinutes.title: Poll interval (minutes)
pollIntervalMinutes.description: How often device data is refreshed from the Daikin cloud. Daikin enforces 200 requests/day; 15 min is recommended.

whiteList.title: White List
whiteList.description: Only the devices in the list will be exposed. If the list is empty, all the devices will be exposed.

blackList.title: Black List
blackList.description: The devices in the list will not be exposed. If the list is empty, no devices will be excluded.

showPowerfulMode.title: Show Powerful Mode
showPowerfulMode.description: Expose Daikin Powerful mode as an OnOff switch child endpoint.

showEconoMode.title: Show Econo Mode
showEconoMode.description: Expose Daikin Econo mode as an OnOff switch child endpoint.

showStreamerMode.title: Show Streamer Mode
showStreamerMode.description: Expose Daikin Streamer mode as an OnOff switch child endpoint.

showOutdoorSilentMode.title: Show Outdoor Silent Mode
showOutdoorSilentMode.description: Expose Daikin outdoor-unit silent mode as an OnOff switch child endpoint.

showIndoorSilentMode.title: Show Indoor Quiet Mode
showIndoorSilentMode.description: Expose Daikin indoor-unit quiet mode as an OnOff switch child endpoint.

unregisterOnShutdown.title: Unregister On Shutdown
unregisterOnShutdown.description: Unregister all devices on shutdown. Debug only.
